# stackra

> Stackra: the TypeScript framework (@stackra/* packages) and its toolchain (gen, CLI, Runway, Figentra Flow preset, docs), in one pnpm + Turborepo monorepo.

## Docs

- [STATE.md](STATE.md): what is proven by a real run, what is not, open risks (2026-11-07)
- [README.md](README.md): overview, quick start, release and licence
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): the agent guide and every repository rule (generated by fflow sync)
- [Repository guide](docs/repository-guide.md): repository map, root commands, how a change lands
- [ADR index](apps/docs/src/docs/adr/index.mdx): every architecture decision
- [ADR numbers](apps/docs/adr/numbers.yaml): reserved ADR numbers
- [Constitution](apps/docs/src/docs/constitution/): the laws an ADR may refine but never contradict
- [Roadmap](apps/docs/src/docs/roadmap.mdx): the plan
- [Runbooks](apps/docs/src/docs/runbooks/): release, deploys, secrets, CI, test infrastructure

## Entry points

- [package.json](package.json): root scripts (verify, validate, gen, release)
- [pnpm-workspace.yaml](pnpm-workspace.yaml): workspace members and the version catalogs
- [mise.toml](mise.toml): pinned toolchain
- [flow.config.json](flow.config.json): Figentra Flow configuration
- [runway.yaml](runway.yaml): deploy targets, environments and providers
- [Packages](packages/README.md): the @stackra/* categories
- [stackra CLI](packages/developer/cli/): the `stackra` command
- [gen](packages/developer/gen/AGENTS.md): code generation and the generated Encore app
- [Runway](packages/developer/runway/README.md): the deploy layer
- [Flow preset](packages/developer/flow-preset/): rules, templates and agents fflow sync renders
- [Rules](.agents/rules/README.md): the rule sources projected into AGENTS.md
- [Specs](.agents/specs/): Figentra Flow specs, one folder per issue
- [Workflows](.github/workflows/README.md): CI, release and deploy workflows
- [Workers](workers/README.md): registry, static, turbo-cache, edge and env-sync Workers
